About

FLYWEISS – an industrial ambition

FLYWEISS DOO SOMBOR is working towards establishing an insect protein production facility in Serbia. We focus on professional operational management, dependable processes and long-term business relationships. The project is currently in its development phase.

Technology & Process

Biology meets industrial process management

Our concept covers the planned rearing and processing of insect larvae and the production of protein-based raw materials. Facility design, process control, hygiene, traceability and quality assurance will be aligned with applicable regulatory requirements as the project progresses.

Products & Applications

Raw materials for tomorrow’s value chains

The project focuses on protein-based products derived from insect larvae and potentially other co-products. Final product specifications and applications will depend on facility design, regulatory approvals, quality requirements and customer agreements.

Sustainability

A considered approach to resources

FLYWEISS aims to establish resource-conscious protein production. Energy efficiency, process optimisation and the evaluation of complementary energy solutions are part of our planning. Quantified environmental benefits will only be published when supported by reliable data and an appropriate baseline.
